                            ↑(outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyHorizon p.toBase p.S p.ρ)) ≤
                        p.ε

∀ (q : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Raw),
  0 < q.m →
    0 < q.n →
      0 < q.S →
        0 < q.K →
          0 < q.ρ →
            q.ρ ≤ 1 →
              0 < q.η →
                ∀ (f : Fin q.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space q.d → ℝ) (lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ : ℝ),
                  0 ≤ Lminus →
                    0 ≤ Lpm →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.RegularObjective f q.x0 lower Lminus Lplus Lpm Δ →
                        q.η ≤ 1 / (Lminus + Lpm * √((1 - q.ρ) / (q.ρ * ↑q.S))) →
                          ∀ (τ : Fin q.n → ENNReal)
                            (O :
                              OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request q.d q.m q.n))
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply q.d q.n)),
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaIndependence.batchScheduleIndependent q f τ O →
                                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit q ≤ N →
                                    have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                    have accuracy := fun z =>
                                      ‖gradient (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f)
                                            (OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q)
                                                (fun x => N) z.1 z.2).1‖ ^
                                        2;
                                    MeasureTheory.Integrable accuracy P ∧
                                      ∫ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                            accuracy z ∂P ≤
                                          2 * (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ↑q.K) ∧
                                        ∀ (ε : ℝ),
                                          0 < ε →
                                            2 * (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.objective f q.x0 - lower) / (q.η * ε) ≤
                                                ↑q.K →
                                              ∫ (z :
                                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                                  accuracy z ∂P ≤
                                                ε
